description: This Dart source file defines the HomeController class, which manages and provides home feed data, continue watching data, and handles cache updates for a Flutter app. It interacts with a ContentRepository to fetch and cache content data, manages loading states, and notifies UI listeners about data changes.

classes.name: HomeController
classes.description: A controller that manages the state and data for the home screen, including loading home feed content, continue watching list, and handling background cache refreshes.

methods.name: loadHomeFeed
methods.description: Loads the home feed data, updates state variables, and initiates continue watching load after fetching.

methods.name: loadContinueWatching
methods.description: Loads the list of recently watched content items for the continue watching feature.

methods.name: refreshFromCache
methods.description: Refreshes data from cache by reloading the home feed and continue watching list.
